name: horse stance hold
description: A wide, low stance held with the knees pushed out over the toes. It builds strength in the inner thighs and hips at the range used for straddles.
instructions: Stand with your feet about twice shoulder width apart and toes turned out slightly.
Sit your hips down until your thighs are near parallel to the floor.
Push your knees out so they stay in line with your toes.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Hold while breathing steadily, then stand up slowly.
